mapper.select:
/* saleson.shop.wishlist.WishlistMapper.getWishlistList */
SELECT WISHLIST_ID, WISHLIST_GROUP_ID, ITEM_ID, ITEM_OPTION, ITEM_OPTION_GROUP_NAME, ITEM_OPTION_NAME, CREATED_DATE FROM OP_WISHLIST

/* saleson.shop.wishlist.WishlistMapper.getWishlistById */ SELECT WISHLIST_ID, WISHLIST_GROUP_ID, ITEM_ID, ITEM_OPTION, ITEM_OPTION_GROUP_NAME, ITEM_OPTION_NAME, CREATED_DATE FROM OP_WISHLIST WHERE WISHLIST_ID = #{value}

/* saleson.shop.wishlist.WishlistMapper.getWishlistDuplicate */ SELECT WISHLIST_ID, WISHLIST_GROUP_ID, ITEM_ID, ITEM_OPTION, ITEM_OPTION_GROUP_NAME, ITEM_OPTION_NAME, CREATED_DATE FROM OP_WISHLIST WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND ITEM_ID = #{itemId}

/* saleson.shop.wishlist.WishlistMapper.getWishlistCountByUserId */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM OP_WISHLIST W INNER JOIN OP_ITEM I ON W.ITEM_ID = I.ITEM_ID INNER JOIN OP_SELLER S ON I.SELLER_ID = S.SELLER_ID
AND W.USER_ID = #{userId} AND I.DATA_STATUS_CODE = '1' AND I.DISPLAY_FLAG = 'Y' AND I.ITEM_DATA_TYPE = '1' AND I.FRONT_DISPLAY_FLAG = 'Y' AND S.STATUS_CODE = '2'

/* saleson.shop.wishlist.WishlistMapper.getWishlistListByUserId */
SELECT W.WISHLIST_ID, W.WISHLIST_GROUP_ID, I.ITEM_ID, I.SELLER_ID, I.ITEM_CODE, I.ITEM_USER_CODE, I.ITEM_NAME, I.ITEM_SUMMARY, I.ITEM_DATA_TYPE, I.ITEM_TYPE, I.ITEM_NEW_FLAG, I.ITEM_LABEL, I.ITEM_TYPE1, I.ITEM_TYPE2, I.ITEM_TYPE3, I.ITEM_TYPE4, I.ITEM_TYPE5, I.ITEM_TYPE6, I.ITEM_TYPE7, I.ITEM_TYPE8, I.ITEM_TYPE9, I.ITEM_TYPE10, I.BRAND_ID, I.BRAND, I.SOLD_OUT, I.STOCK_FLAG, I.STOCK_QUANTITY, I.NONMEMBER_ORDER_TYPE, I.TAX_TYPE, I.COMMISSION_TYPE, I.COMMISSION_RATE, I.PRICE_CRITERIA,
I.ITEM_PRICE, I.COST_PRICE, I.SUPPLY_PRICE, I.SALE_PRICE, I.SALE_PRICE_NONMEMBER_FLAG, I.SALE_PRICE_NONMEMBER,
I.SPOT_FLAG, I.SPOT_DATE_TYPE, I.SPOT_TYPE, I.SPOT_APPLY_GROUP, I.SPOT_DISCOUNT_AMOUNT, I.SPOT_START_DATE, I.SPOT_END_DATE, I.SPOT_START_TIME, I.SPOT_END_TIME, I.SPOT_WEEK_DAY,
I.SELLER_DISCOUNT_FLAG, I.SELLER_DISCOUNT_TYPE, I.SELLER_DISCOUNT_AMOUNT, I.SELLER_POINT_FLAG,
I.SET_DISCOUNT_TYPE, I.SET_DISCOUNT_AMOUNT, I.ITEM_IMAGE, I.ITEM_OPTION_FLAG, I.ITEM_OPTION_TYPE, I.ITEM_OPTION_TITLE1, I.ITEM_OPTION_TITLE2, I.ITEM_OPTION_TITLE3, I.DATA_STATUS_CODE, I.DISPLAY_FLAG, I.COUPON_USE_FLAG, I.NAVER_SHOPPING_ITEM_NAME, I.NAVER_SHOPPING_FLAG, I.NAVER_PAY_FLAG,
I.PRIVATE_TYPE, (SELECT UPPER_LOCGOV_NM || ' ' || LOCGOV_NM FROM G_LOCGOV WHERE LOCGOV_CODE = S.LOCGOV_CODE) AS LOCGOV_NM, S.LOCGOV_CODE, I.REPRESENTATIVE_ITEM_YN, I.MINOR_ALLOW_FLAG, I.ORIGIN_COUNTRY, I.MANUFACTURER, I.COLOR, I.WEIGHT, I.SALE_POINT,
I.STOCK_CODE, I.STOCK_SCHEDULE_AUTO_FLAG, I.STOCK_SCHEDULE_TYPE, I.STOCK_SCHEDULE_DATE, I.STOCK_SCHEDULE_TEXT, I.ORDER_MIN_QUANTITY, I.ORDER_MAX_QUANTITY, I.SALE_QUANTITY,
I.ITEM_ADDITION_FLAG, I.FREE_GIFT_FLAG, I.FREE_GIFT_NAME, I.ITEM_KEYWORD, I.ITEM_NOTICE_CODE, I.TEAM, I.OPENTIME, I.OTHER_FLAG, I.RECOMMEND_FLAG, I.RELATION_ITEM_DISPLAY_TYPE, I.DELIVERY_COMPANY_ID, I.DELIVERY_COMPANY_NAME, I.DELIVERY_TYPE, I.ITEM_RETURN_FLAG, I.HITS,
I.MD_ID, I.MD_NAME,
I.SHIPPING_TYPE, I.SHIPPING, I.SHIPPING_FREE_AMOUNT,
I.UPDATED_USER_ID, I.UPDATED_DATE, I.CREATED_USER_ID, I.CREATED_DATE, I.ERP_EXCEPTION_TYPE, ( CASE WHEN I.SOLD_OUT = '1' THEN 'Y' WHEN I.ITEM_OPTION_FLAG = 'N' AND I.STOCK_FLAG = 'Y' AND I.STOCK_QUANTITY = 0 THEN 'Y' WHEN I.ITEM_OPTION_FLAG = 'Y' AND I.ITEM_OPTION_TYPE = 'T' AND I.STOCK_FLAG = 'Y' AND I.STOCK_QUANTITY = 0 THEN 'Y' WHEN I.ITEM_OPTION_FLAG = 'Y' AND IOST.ITEM_OPTION_SOLD_OUT_FLAG = 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS ITEM_SOLD_OUT_FLAG, IFNULL(IOST.ITEM_OPTION_SOLD_OUT_FLAG, 'N') AS ITEM_OPTION_SOLD_OUT_FLAG, W.CREATED_DATE FROM OP_ITEM I INNER JOIN ( SELECT WISHLIST_ID, WISHLIST_GROUP_ID, CREATED_DATE, ITEM_ID, USER_ID FROM OP_WISHLIST WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ) W ON W.ITEM_ID = I.ITEM_ID INNER JOIN OP_SELLER S ON I.SELLER_ID = S.SELLER_ID LEFT JOIN OP_ITEM_OPTION_SOLDOUT IOST ON I.ITEM_ID = IOST.ITEM_ID
AND W.USER_ID = #{userId} AND I.DATA_STATUS_CODE = '1' AND I.DISPLAY_FLAG = 'Y' AND I.ITEM_DATA_TYPE = '1' AND I.ITEM_TYPE IN ('1', '3')
AND I.PRIVATE_TYPE IN (
#{privateType}
)
AND I.MINOR_ALLOW_FLAG = 'Y'
AND I.FRONT_DISPLAY_FLAG = 'Y' AND S.STATUS_CODE = '2'
